content.title: All About Bhad Bhabie's Daughter Kali Love (Including What the Rapper Has Said to Her Parenting Critics)
content.text: Bhad Bhabie and her daughter Kali. Credit : Paras Griffin/Getty; Kali Love/Instagram Bhad Bhabie rose to fame after her tumultuous relationship with her mom was featured on the Dr. Phil show in 2016, but these days, the former “troubled teen” is a mother herself. The rapper, née Danielle Bregoli, welcomed her first child, daughter Kali Love, with her on-and-off boyfriend, Le Vaughn, in March 2024. The couple started dating in July 2020 and announced that they were expecting a baby together in December 2023. “I feel very ready to be a mom,” Bhabie told Paper magazine in February 2024. “I’m so excited to do all of the little ‘mom and daughter’ things together. I can’t wait to dress her up, take her shopping, spend 1-on-1 time and travel all over. Just the simple things.” She went on to talk about her future with Le Vaughn, saying she was especially excited to “start my own little family and make new memories together.” Since then, the pair's relationship has been on-and-off, according to a May 2025 podcast interview with Camilla Araujo. During that same interview, Bhabie gushed about motherhood, saying, “The things that make me happy are just being a mom.” When asked what she likes most about it, the rapper explained that she enjoys seeing her daughter learn and grow. “I just like watching her do things,” she said, adding that Kali already “has my attitude.” Here’s everything to know about Bhad Bhabie’s daughter, Kali. Bhabie felt ready to become a mother Bhad Babie and Le Vaughn attend the Los Angeles premiere of "Drugstore June" at TCL Chinese 6 Theatres on February 20, 2024 in Hollywood, California. Olivia Wong/Getty On Dec. 1, 2023, Bhabie announced her pregnancy on social media. In a since-deleted Instagram post, the rapper shared a couple of selfies, proudly showing off her baby bump. Later that month, Bhabie revealed that she and Le Vaughn were having a baby girl with an elaborate photo shoot on a motorcycle in collaboration with Marc Jacobs. “I'm really excited for her,” she told PEOPLE in February 2024. The then-20-year-old went on to address the criticism about her becoming a mom at such a young age. “I even see people saying, 'Oh, I don't think she's ready. I don't think she's ready.' It's like, how can you, from your computer screen, determine if I'm ready to be a mother or not?” she said. Bhabie and Le Vaugn had a Valentine’s Day-themed baby shower Le Vaughn and daughter Kali in May 2025. Le Vaughn/Instagram In early February 2024, Bhabie and Le Vaughn revealed their daughter's name in a lavish, Valentine’s Day-themed baby shower. "The name doesn't really have any specific meaning, it's just his mom picked the middle name and then I had a list of five names I liked, and Kali was one of them," Bhabie told PEOPLE. "I thought that Love went good with Kali." The shower included heart-shaped arches, wreaths of pink balloons, large baby blocks, candles and red roses everywhere. The venue was also decked out with a large, neon pink sign bearing Kali Love's name. “It came out better than I imagined and I can't wait to show our baby girl these photos when she gets older,” the rapper told E! News. Kali was born in March 2024 Bhad Bhabie's daughter Kali. Le Vaughn/Instagram Bhabie and Le Vaughn welcomed Kali Love on March 14, 2024. The rapper confirmed the news with a sweet black-and-white photo of her and her newborn baby girl, whose face was covered with a hat and blanket, on her Instagram Stories. A few months later, on Mother’s Day, Bhabie shared a picture of her daughter’s face for the first time in another Instagram Stories post. She also posted a throwback photo of herself as a baby with the words, “Kali my twin,” over the image. Bhabie felt an immediate connection with her Bhad Bhabie's daughter Kali. Kali Love/Instagram In her May 2025 podcast interview with Araujo, Bhabie shared that she felt an immediate connection with Kali from the moment she was born. “It’s so crazy because I’m such a selfish person,” she admitted, adding that having a daughter brought out a more nurturing, loving side. Describing the moment that Kali was born, Bhabie explained, “I literally looked at her [and] everything from that moment became about her.” Kali was an easy baby Bhad Bhabie's daughter Kali. Le Vaughn/Instagram During her interview with Araujo, Bhabie opened up about experiencing postpartum depression, despite the fact that she had “an easy baby.” “My baby was so easy, oh my god,” she said of Kali, adding that, regardless, she went through a period of postpartum depression following her birth. “I had to get on anti-depressants and I had a partner, I had a nanny, my baby was easy.” Bhabie and her mom got tattoos of Kali's name Bhad Bhabie. Bhad Bhabie/Instagram In May 2024, Bhabie’s mom, Barbara Bregoli, shared on Instagram that both she and her daughter got some new ink. “We both got Kali girls name tattooed,” she wrote alongside a photo of their tattoos. While it’s unclear where Barbara’s tattoo is located, Bhabie’s is featured prominently on the front of her neck in red ink. Her first birthday was Disney-themed Bhad Bhabie's daughter Kali. Le Vaughn/Instagram Kali turned one on March 14, 2025. A few days later, she celebrated the milestone with an elaborate, Disney-themed birthday party. Barbara shared several pictures of the event on Instagram with the caption, “My beautiful granddaughter Kali’s 1st birthday party 👑🎂🥰.” Kali’s Instagram page, which is run by her parents, also showcased the party, which included a castle bouncey house, face-painting, balloon animals, cotton candy in the shape of mouse ears and several Disney characters in person, including Micky Mouse, Minnie Mouse, Daisy Duck and Cinderella.
